ssh_root_cause: Signed minimal ARM runtime images omit openssh-clients. SshServer.qtest invokes absolute /usr/bin/ssh and /usr/bin/sftp; failed client startup leaves acceptSession with no peer, eventually reaching unchanged suite deadline. The RPM build spec already requires these clients for its source tests.
ssh_correction: Add openssh-clients as a runtime fixture dependency on all three families. No compiler or SDK dependency and no timeout change. Existing five local SSH/VSS installed checks pass with this distribution package available. Native repeat required.
negative_controls: Both ZeroMQ phases reject missing, relative and non-qmod module paths; complete pinned fixture inventories use existing negative validation tests. Initial misplaced command branch was caught by seven failures and corrected before this commit.
qualification_status: Native SSH rerun and final ZeroMQ signed ARM manifest execution pending.
